## 🎙️ Voice Preprocessing Code Node

**Purpose:** Initial processing of voice webhook input

**Key Functions:**
• Validates incoming audio binary data
• Extracts session metadata from voice webhook
• Prepares audio data for Whisper transcription
• Sets up voice-specific data structure
• Handles missing audio with error messages

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Voice Webhook → audio binary + metadata
• **OUT:** → Whisper STT (audio transcription)

**Output:** Voice metadata + audio binary ready for transcription

# 🌟 ALPINE PEAK VOICE CHATBOT WORKFLOW - FIXED RAG

## Overview
Complete RAG-powered chatbot with FIXED embedding integration

## KEY FIX APPLIED
✅ **Embeddings OpenAI node now properly connected**
✅ **Text flows through embeddings BEFORE vector search**
✅ **Using latest n8n v1.112.0 compatible nodes**

## Key Features
✅ **Dual Input**: Text + Voice webhooks
✅ **RAG Knowledge Base**: Supabase vector store with embeddings
✅ **Voice Processing**: Whisper STT + Nova TTS
✅ **CRM Integration**: Lead capture + conversation logging
✅ **Email Follow-up**: Automated knowledge sharing
✅ **Emergency Handling**: Priority routing

## Webhook Endpoints
**Text**: `/webhook/alpine-peak-chatbot`
**Voice**: `/webhook/alpine-peak-voice-chat`

## Credentials Required
- OpenAI API (GPT-4, Whisper, TTS, Embeddings)
- Supabase API (Vector store + CRM)
- Gmail OAuth2 (Email sending)

## Architecture Flow
1. Webhook Entry → 2. Preprocessing → 3. EMBEDDINGS → 4. RAG Search → 5. AI Response → 6. TTS (voice) → 7. CRM Logging → 8. Email Follow-up

**Fixed using n8n MCP Server validation for n8n v1.112.0**

## 📥 Text Webhook Node

**Purpose:** Entry point for text-based chatbot interactions

**Key Configuration:**
• **Endpoint:** `/webhook/alpine-peak-chatbot`
• **Method:** POST requests only
• **Response Mode:** responseNode (requires separate response node)
• **Data Flow:** Receives JSON with message, session_id, page_context

**Expected Input Format:**
```json
{
  "message": "User's text message",
  "session_id": "unique_session_identifier", 
  "page_context": "website_contact_form"
}
```

**Connections:**
• **OUT:** → Text Preprocessing (message validation & analysis)

**Security:** External webhook - validate all inputs in preprocessing

## 🎤 Voice Webhook Node

**Purpose:** Entry point for voice-based chatbot interactions

**Key Configuration:**
• **Endpoint:** `/webhook/alpine-peak-voice-chat`
• **Method:** POST requests with audio binary data
• **Response Mode:** responseNode (requires separate response node)
• **Binary Property:** 'audio' for voice file handling
• **Data Flow:** Receives audio file + optional metadata

**Expected Input Format:**
- **Binary:** Audio file (WAV, MP3, M4A, etc.)
- **JSON:** Optional session_id, page_context, user_data

**Connections:**
• **OUT:** → Voice Preprocessing (audio validation & metadata setup)

**Audio Formats:** Supports all Whisper-compatible formats
**Security:** Validate audio size limits and file types

## 🗣️ Whisper Transcription Node

**Purpose:** Converts voice audio to text using OpenAI's Whisper STT

**Key Configuration:**
• **Model:** Whisper (OpenAI's speech-to-text)
• **Resource:** Audio transcription
• **Operation:** Transcribe audio to text
• **Input:** Binary audio data from Voice Preprocessing
• **Output:** Transcribed text + confidence metadata

**Technical Details:**
• **Supported Formats:** MP3, MP4, MPEG, MPGA, M4A, WAV, WEBM
• **Max File Size:** 25 MB per audio file
• **Languages:** Auto-detection of 50+ languages
• **Accuracy:** High accuracy for clear speech

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Voice Preprocessing → audio binary data
• **OUT:** → Voice Processing (text + voice metadata merge)

**Error Handling:** Returns '[unclear audio]' for failed transcriptions

## 🧠 Extract Knowledge Build Prompt Node

**Purpose:** Combines RAG search results with user data to create comprehensive AI context

**Key Functions:**
• **Knowledge Integration:** Processes vector search results from Supabase
• **Context Building:** Combines knowledge content with user intent and metadata
• **Prompt Engineering:** Creates system prompt with company information and guidelines
• **Data Consolidation:** Merges text/voice preprocessing data into unified structure
• **Session Management:** Maintains session continuity across text and voice inputs
• **Intent Preservation:** Carries forward user intent, priority, and lead scoring

**System Prompt Components:**
• **Company Details:** Phone, services, specialties, scheduling links
• **Knowledge Context:** RAG-retrieved content relevant to user query
• **Instructions:** Behavioral guidelines for AI assistant "Sarah"
• **Emergency Protocols:** Special handling for urgent roofing issues
• **Contact Workflows:** Email capture and scheduling guidance

**Data Consolidation:**
```json
{
  "system_prompt": "Complete AI instructions...",
  "user_message": "User's question",
  "input_type": "text|voice",
  "user_email": "if_provided",
  "session_id": "session_123",
  "intent": "emergency|estimation|general",
  "priority": "urgent|high|normal",
  "lead_score": 45,
  "has_email": true,
  "timestamp": "2025-01-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Extract Knowledge → RAG results + Text/Voice Processing → user data
• **OUT:** → Is Voice Input? (routing decision)

## 🔄 Extract AI Response Node

**Purpose:** Processes and standardizes AI response data for webhook delivery

**Key Functions:**
• **Response Extraction:** Gets AI message from multiple possible formats
• **Content Formatting:** Handles both message.content and direct content fields
• **Success Indicators:** Adds success flags and timestamps
• **Data Standardization:** Creates consistent response structure
• **Fallback Handling:** Provides default messages if AI response is empty

**Input Sources:**
• AI Response1 → GPT-4 chat completion
• TTS Generation1 → Audio synthesis results (for voice responses)

**Output Structure:**
```json
{
  "message": "AI response text",
  "success": true,
  "timestamp": "2025-01-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```

**Connections:**
• **IN:** AI Response OR TTS Generation
• **OUT:** → Build Response Metadata (final packaging)

## 📦 Build Response Metadata Node

**Purpose:** Creates comprehensive response package with metadata for webhooks and downstream processing

**Key Functions:**
• **Response Packaging:** Combines AI message with metadata
• **Audio URL Handling:** Includes TTS audio URLs for voice responses
• **CTA Integration:** Adds contextual call-to-action messages
• **Knowledge Tracking:** Records which knowledge sources were used
• **Email Data:** Prepares user email and knowledge data for email pipeline
• **Session Management:** Maintains session continuity

**Response Structure:**
```json
{
  "response": {
    "message": "AI response",
    "audio_url": "https://...", 
    "type": "text|voice",
    "session_id": "session_123",
    "cta": "Schedule at calendly.com/..."
  },
  "metadata": {
    "input_type": "text|voice",
    "intent": "emergency|estimation|etc",
    "email_captured": true,
    "knowledge_used": true,
    "knowledge_sources": [...],
    "user_email": "user@email.com"
  }
}
```

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Extract AI Response → formatted AI message
• **OUT:** → Lead Capture + Webhook Response + Email Pipeline

## ✉️ Format Email For Gmail Node

**Purpose:** Prepares personalized email content with knowledge base information for Gmail delivery

**Key Functions:**
• **Email Personalization:** Extracts user email from metadata
• **Subject Generation:** Creates dynamic subjects based on user intent
• **Content Packaging:** Formats HTML email content for Gmail
• **Knowledge Integration:** Includes relevant knowledge base articles
• **Fallback Handling:** Uses default email if user email not provided

**Email Template Features:**
• **Company Branding:** Alpine Peak Roofing colors and styling
• **Knowledge Sections:** Formatted knowledge base content
• **Clear CTAs:** Emergency phone + Calendly scheduling links
• **Professional Layout:** HTML email with responsive design
• **Contact Information:** Phone, website, company tagline

**Data Processing:**
```json
{
  "user_email": "customer@email.com",
  "subject": "Alpine Peak Roofing - Information About [Intent]",
  "email_content": "<html>formatted email</html>"
}
```

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Generate Email HTML → formatted HTML content
• **OUT:** → Send Email (Gmail delivery)

**Email Triggers:** Only sends when user provided email + knowledge available

## 📝 Text Preprocessing Code Node

**Purpose:** Processes incoming text webhook messages

**Key Functions:**
• Extracts and validates message text from webhook body
• Detects email addresses using regex pattern
• Analyzes user intent (emergency, estimation, scheduling, etc.)
• Calculates lead scoring based on content and email presence
• Sets priority levels (urgent, high, normal)
• Prepares structured data for RAG pipeline

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Text Webhook → message + session data
• **OUT:** → Embeddings OpenAI (text vectorization)

**Output:** Clean message data with intent analysis and lead scoring

## 🎤 Voice Processing Code Node

**Purpose:** Processes voice transcription and enriches voice data

**Key Functions:**
• Extracts transcribed text from Whisper STT output
• Handles unclear audio with fallback messages
• Detects email addresses in voice transcriptions
• Performs intent analysis on spoken content
• Applies voice interaction bonus to lead scoring
• Merges voice metadata with transcription results

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Whisper STT → transcribed text + Voice Preprocessing → metadata
• **OUT:** → Embeddings OpenAI (text vectorization)

**Output:** Structured voice data ready for RAG pipeline with enhanced scoring

## 🧠 Build Context Code Node

**Purpose:** Creates comprehensive AI context from RAG search results

**Key Functions:**
• Processes vector search results from Supabase
• Extracts knowledge sources (title + content)
• Builds formatted RAG context for AI prompt
• Creates dynamic system prompt with company info
• Adds voice-specific or emergency-specific instructions
• Combines original data with knowledge context

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Knowledge Search → RAG results + Text/Voice Processing → user data
• **OUT:** → AI Response (GPT-4 chat completion)

**Output:** Complete context package for AI with RAG knowledge and system prompt

## 📤 Format Response Code Node

**Purpose:** Formats AI response for webhook delivery and downstream processing

**Key Functions:**
• Extracts AI response from multiple possible formats
• Applies markdown formatting for text responses
• Handles TTS audio URL generation for voice
• Creates context-aware call-to-action messages
• Builds comprehensive metadata including knowledge sources
• Passes user email and knowledge data to email pipeline

**Connections:**
• **IN:** AI Response → GPT response + TTS Generation → audio + Build Context → user data
• **OUT:** → Webhook Response + Should Send Email? + Log Conversation

**Output:** Complete response object with text/audio + metadata for webhooks and emails

## 📧 Prepare Email Code Node

**Purpose:** Builds personalized email content with RAG knowledge

**Key Functions:**
• Retrieves knowledge sources from Format Response metadata
• Creates HTML email template with company branding
• Includes relevant knowledge base articles in email
• Adds proper call-to-action with correct Calendly links
• Handles cases with no knowledge gracefully
• Generates dynamic subject lines based on intent

**Connections:**
• **IN:** Should Send Email? → Format Response metadata
• **OUT:** → Send Email (Gmail)

**Output:** Complete email package (content, subject, recipient) ready for Gmail sending
